text:
kim: Opening a small PR to tidy the Quickstart hello-world steps: simplify auth wording, add a minimal curl test and a Vercel serverless note, and update one SDK snippet to client v8 style. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5211 (WIP).
oliver: split the SDK change into its own commit please, makes review easier.
sam: please include a short curl example under 'Test locally' so folks can rule out network vs SDK issues.
kim: will add. curl example I'm planning: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hello from curl"}'`
kim: also adding a 2-line Vercel serverless snippet + note: cache ephemeral token only per invocation.
oliver: add a one-liner recommending pinning model versions in examples (avoid silent regressions).
sam: tiny nit: keep env var name REDWOOD_API_KEY across all samples.
kim: affirmed. I'll fix the broken deploy link (was pointing to old path) and add local smoke test steps: `npm ci && npm run start` then run the curl.
docs-bot: preview build queued for PR 5211  ETA ~6m
docs-bot: preview for PR 5211 finished (status: success)  https://deploy-preview-5211--docs.redwood.ai
sam: preview looks good, will review the SDK commit after lunch.
kim: thanks all  merging once CI passes and creating follow-up issue to migrate remaining snippets to client v8. Closing thread.
